validation.root_oracle_cross_check: Both red-pillar windows and all four trees, A_j reconstructed from marginal leaf PMF times existing root probability.

interpretation: Neither controlled substitution reproduces the red-pillar penalty. The full repartition across brick boundaries changes the conditional proposals below the root. The nonadditive remainder does not identify a pure interaction between two independently combined edits.
Optimizing only the root of the global candidate removes about 14% of its excess conditional variance over World Prefix. Around 2.39–2.40 times the prefix variance remains.

Upper-only preserves the red pillar, improves ls5 and all moving-4 sampled faces, and improves the older ls1 points. It loses the global candidate improvement on the new central ceiling, where variance rises above World Prefix.
This is a finite fixed-receiver diagnostic with intact bricks as an experimental control. It does not establish a runtime fix or limit future cross-brick clustering.
